description: This file defines the main entry point for a plugin process in the Thunder framework, including classes for worker pool management, process options parsing, and process lifecycle control. It handles plugin loading, environment setup, and process startup/shutdown procedures.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Implements a worker pool with IPC server capabilities, thread dispatching, and callback handling within the Thunder plugin process.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: A callback class for monitoring service objects and signaling the worker pool to stop when no objects remain.

classes.name: ConsoleOptions
classes.description: Parses and manages command-line options for the plugin process, including paths, environment variables, and interface parameters.

classes.name: ProcessFlow
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of the plugin process, including startup, shutdown, and interface acquisition, and handles process communication setup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the plugin process, handling argument parsing, environment setup, process startup, and cleanup.

methods.name: ProcessFlow::Startup
methods.description: Initializes the process with thread count, remote node, and callsign, setting up communication channels.

methods.name: ProcessFlow::Run
methods.description: Loads proxy stubs, opens communication, and runs the worker pool for the plugin.

methods.name: ConsoleOptions::Option
methods.description: Parses individual command-line options and sets corresponding member variables.
